text: Triseratops angeutumia mdomo wake wenye nguvu kuyatoa majani kabla ya kula shina.
text_en: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Wanasayansi wengine wanadai kuwa mimea hii ina sumu kali na kwa hiyo hakuna uwezekano kuwa dinosaria yeyote aliila, ingawa leo hii wavivu na wanyama wengine kama kasuku (kizazi cha dinosaria) wanaweza kula majani au matunda ya sumu.
text_en: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Mvuto wa lo ungewezaje kunivuta? Kama ungesimama katika uso wa lo, ungekuwa na uzani mdogo kuliko ulionao duniani.
text_en: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Mtu aliye na uzito wa pauni 200 (kilogramu 90) duniani anaweza kuwa na uzito wa pauni 36 (kilogramu 16) kwenye lo. Kwa hivyo mvuto, bila shaka, huvuta kidogo sana kwako.
text_en: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Jua halina ganda gumu kama Dunia ambayo unaweza kusimama kwayo. Jua zima limetengenezwa kwa gesi, moto, na gesi ya utegili.
text_en: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Gesi huwa nyembamba kadiri unavyosonga mbali na Jua.
text_en: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Sehemu ya nje tunayoona tunapotazama jua inaitwa photosphere, kumaanisha “mpira wa mwanga”.
text_en: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Takribani miaka elfu tatu baadaye, mnamo 1610, Mnajimu Muitaliano Galileo Galilei alitumia darubini kuangalia kwamba Zuhura ina awamu, kama vile mwezi.
text_en: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Awamu hufanyika kwa sababu tu upande wa Zuhura (au wa Mwezi) unaoegemea upande wa Jua hupata mwanga. Awamu za Zuhura ziliunga mkono nadharia ya Kopernikasi kwamba sayari zinazunguka Jua.
text_en: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Kisha, miaka michache baadaye mwaka wa 1639, mnajimu Mwingereza aliyeitwa Jeremiah Horrocks alitazama safari ya Venus.
text_en: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: Uingereza ilikuwa na uzoefu wa kipindi kirefu cha amani baada ya kushinda upya Danelaw.
text_en: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Walakini mnamo 991 Ethelred alikabiliwa na kundi la manowari la Viking kubwa kuliko lolote tangu la Guthrum karne moja mapema.
text_en: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Manowari hizi ziliongozwa na Olaf Trygvasson, Mnorwei aliye na matarajio ya kurudisha nchi yake kutoka kwa utawala wa Kidenmaki.
text_en: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Baada ya vipingamizi vya kwanza vya kijeshi, Ethelred aliweza kukubaliana kimasharti na Olaf, ambaye alirudi Norwe ili kujaribu kupata ufalme wake, kwa mafanikio mseto.
text_en: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Hangeul ndiyo alfabeti ya kipekee iliyovumbuliwa kimakusudi inayotumika kimaarufu kila siku. Alfabeti hiyo ilivumbuliwa mwaka wa 1444 wakati wa utawala wa Mfalme Sejong (1418 – 1450).
text_en: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Mfalme Sejong alikua ndiye mfalme wa nne kwenye Nasaba ya Joseon na ndiye aliyezingatiwa Zaidi.
text_en: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Mwanzoni aliipatia alfabeti ya Hangeul jina la Hunmin Jeongeum, kumaanisha “sauti sahihi za maagizo kwa watu”.
text_en: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Kuna nadharia nyingi kuhusu vile Sanskrit ilikuja kuwepo. Mojawapo ni kuhusu uhamaji wa Aryan kutoka magharibi hadi India waliokuja na lugha yao.
text_en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Sanskrit ni lugha ya kale na inaweza kulinganishwa na lugha ya Kilatini inayozungumzwa Uropa.
text_en: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Kitabu cha mapema zaidi kijulikanacho duniani kiliandikwa kwa Sanskrit. Baada ya utungaji wa Upanishads, Sanskrit ilififia tu kwa sababu ya mfumo wa viwango.
text_en: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Sanskrit ni lugha tata na tajiri sana, ambayo imekuwa chanzo cha lugha nyingi za kisasa za Kihindi, kama vile Kilatini ilivyo chanzo cha lugha za Kizungu kama vile Kifaransa na Kispanya.
text_en: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Vita kwa Ufaransa vikiwa vimekwisha, Ujerumani ilianza kujitayarisha kuvamia kisiwa cha Uingereza.
text_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Ujerumani ililipa shambulio jina lililosimbwa la "Operation Sealion". Silaha nyingi nzito na vifaa vya Jeshi la Uingereza vilikuwa vimepotea wakati wa kutoka Dunkirk, kwa hivyo jeshi lilikuwa dhaifu kiasi.
text_en: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Lakini Nevi ya Kifalme bado ilikuwa imara sana zaidi ya Nevi ya Ujerumani ("Kriegsmarine") na ingeweza kuangamiza kikosi chochote cha ushambuliaji kilichotumwa katika Mlango-bahari wa Uingereza.
text_en: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Kwa hali yoyote, ni meli chache sana za jeshi la kifalme zilizo karibu na njia za uvamizi kwa sababu wanahofia kusamishwa na mashambulizi ya hewa ya Kijerumani.
text_en: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Hebu tuanze na maelezo kuhusu mipango ya Italia. Italia ilikuwa hasa “kaka mdogo” wa Ujerumani na Japani.
text_en: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Ilikuwa na jeshi dhaifu na nevi dhaifu, ingawa walikuwa wamejenga tu meli nne mpya kabla ya kuanza kwa vita.
text_en: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Malengo makuu ya Italiano yalikuwa nchi za Kiafrika. Ili kunasa nchi hizo, walihitaji kuwa na pedi ya kurushia vikosi, ili vikosi viweze kusafiri katika Bahari ya Mediteranea na kuishambulia Afrika.
text_en: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Kwa hayo, walihitaji kuondoa kambi na meli za Uingereza kutoka Misri. Zaidi ya hatua hizo, manowari za Italia hazikupaswa kufanya lingine lolote.
text_en: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Sasa kwa Japani. Japani ilikuwa nchi ya kisiwa, kama vile Uingereza.
text_en: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Sabmarini ni meli zilizoundwa kusafiri chini ya maji, na kubaki hapo kwa muda mrefu.
text_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Nyambizi zilitumiwa katika vita vya pili vya dunia. Wakati huo zilisonga polepole sana na zilikuwa na masafa mafupi sana ya upigaji risasi.
text_en: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Mwanzoni mwa vita zilisonga mara nyingi juu ya bahari, lakini kadiri rada ilivyoanza kukua na kupata usahihi zaidi nyambizi zililazimika kuzama chini ya maji ili kuepuka kuonekana.
text_en: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Manowari za Ujerumani ziliitwa nyambizi. Wajerumani walikuwa wazuri sana kwa kuabiri na kuendesha manowari zao.
text_en: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Kwa sababu ya mafanikio yao na nyambizi, baada ya vita Wajerumani hawaaminiki kuwa na nyingi zazo.
text_en: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Ndiyo! Mfalme Tutankhamuni, ambaye wakati mwingine hutambuliwa kama “Mfalme Tuti” au “Mfalme Mvulana”, ni mmojawapo wa wafalme wa zamani wa Misri wanaojulikana sana katika nyakati za sasa.
text_en: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Kwa kushangaza, hakuchukuliwa kuwa muhimu katika zamani za kale na hakurekodiwa kwenye nyingi za orodha za wafalme.
text_en: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Hata hivyo, ugunduzi wa kaburi lake mnamo 1922 ulimfanya mtu mashuhuri. Huku makaburi mengi ya zamani yakiporwa, kaburi hili liliachwa karibu bila kusumbuliwa kamwe.
text_en: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Vitu vingi vilivyozikwa na Tutankhamun vimehifadhiwa vizuri, ikiwa ni pamoja na maelfu ya sanaa zilizoundwa kutoka kwa madini ya thamani na mawe adimu.
text_en: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Uvumbuzi wa magurudumu ya spoki ulifanya magari ya Ashuru yawe mepesi, haraka, na yaliyo tayari zaidi kushinda askari na magari mengine.
text_en: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Mishale kutoka kwenye nyuta zao hatari ingeweza kupenya ngao za askari wapinzani. Takribani 1000 BC, Waashuru walianzisha farasi wa kwanza wa vita.
text_en: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Askari farasi ni jeshi linalopigana juu ya farasi. Matandiko yalikuwa bado hayajavumbuliwa, kwa hivyo askari farasi wa Ashuru walipigana kwenye migongo tupu ya farasi wao.
text_en: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Tunawajua wengi wa wanasiasa, wanasayansi na wasanii wa Ugiriki. Yamkini mtu anayejulikana sana katika utamaduni huu ni Homer, malenga wa mashairi aliyekuwa kipofu, aliyebuni tungo mbili bora sana za fasihi ya Kigiriki: mashairi Iliad na Odyssey.
text_en: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sophocles na Aristophanes bado ni waandishi maarufu wa michezo ya kuigiza na michezo yao huzingatiwa kuwa miongoni mwa kazi kubwa za fasihi ya ulimwengu.
text_en: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Mgiriki mwingine maarufu ni Pythagoras, anayejulikana sana kwa nadharia zake maarufu za hisabati kuhusu uhusiano wa pande za pembe tatu zenye pembemraba.
text_en: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Kuna makadirio yanayotofautiana kuhusu idadi ya watu wanaozungumza Kihindi. Inakadiriwa kuwa kati ya lugha nambari mbili na nne inayozungumzwa zaidi duniani.
text_en: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Idadi ya wazungumzaji wenyeji hutofautiana kulingana na kama lahaja zinazohusiana kwa karibu sana zinahesabiwa au la.
text_en: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Makadirio yanafikia wasemaji milioni 340 hadi milioni 500, na watu wengi kama milioni 800 wanaweza kuielewa lugha hiyo.
text_en: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Kihindi na Kiurdu zinafanana kwa msamiati lakini tofauti katika hati; katika mazungumzo ya kila siku, wazungumzaji wa lugha zote mbili wanaweza kuelewana.
text_en: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Karibu karne ya 15, Estonia kaskazini ilikuwa chini ya ushawishi mkubwa wa kiutamaduni wa Ujerumani.
text_en: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Watawa wengine wa Kijerumani walitaka kumleta Mungu karibu na watu asili, kwa hivyo wakabuni lugha halisi ya Kiestonia
text_en: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Ilihusishwa na alfabeti ya kijerumani na alfabeti moja "Õ/õ" ikaongezwa.
text_en: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Kadiri muda ulivyopita, maneno mengi yaliyoombwa kutoka Ujerumani yalichanganyika. Huu ulikuwa mwanzo wa uelewa.
text_en: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Kitamaduni, mrithi wa kiti cha enzi angeenda moja kwa moja kwa uanajeshi baada ya kuhitimu shuleni.
text_en: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Walakini, Charles alienda katika Trinity College, Cambridge mahali alisomea Anthropolojia na Akiolojia, na baadaye Historia, akapokea 2:2 (shahada ya pili kutoka chini).
text_en: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Charles alikuwa memba wa kwanza wa Familia ya Kifalme ya Kiingereza kuzawadiwa shahada ya digrii.
text_en: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: Uturuki ya Ulaya (Thrace mashariki au Rumelia katika rasi ya Balka) inajumuisha asilimia 3 ya nchi.
text_en: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Wilaya ya Uturuki ni zaidi ya kilomita 1,600 (maili 1,000) urefu na kilomita 800 (maili 500) upana, na takriban umbo la mstatili.
text_en: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Sehemu ya Uturuki, pamoja na maziwa, imekalia kilomita mraba 783, 562 (maili mraba 300, 948), ambazo kilomita mraba 755,688 (maili mraba 291,773) kati yake ziko kusini magharibi mwa Asia na kilomita mraba 23,764 (maili mraba 9,174) ziko barani Ulaya.
text_en: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Eneo la Uturuki huifanya kuwa nchi ya 37 kwa ukubwa duniani, na ina takriban saizi za Ufaransa ya Uropa na Uingereza kwa pamoja.
text_en: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Uturuki imezungukwa na maziwa katika pande tatu: Bahari ya Aegea upande wa magharibi, Bahari Nyeusi upande wa kaskazini na Bahari ya Mediterania upande wa kusini.
text_en: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Luxembourg ina historia ndefu lakini uhuru wake ni wa kutoka mwaka wa 1839.
text_en: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Baadhi ya sehemu za sasa za Ubelgiji zilikuwa sehemu ya Lusembagi zamani lakini zikawa za Kibelgiji baada ya Mapinduzi ya Kibelgiji ya 1830.
text_en: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Lusembagi daima imejaribu kuwa nchi isiyoegemea upande wowote lakini ilichukuliwa na Ujerumani katika Vita vya kwanza na vya pili vya Dunia.
text_en: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Mnamo 1957 Luxembourg ikawa memba mwanzilishi wa shirika ambalo leo linajulikana kama Umoja wa Ulaya.
text_en: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Drukgyal Dzong ni ngome iliyoharibika na monasteri ya Kibudhi katika sehemu ya juu ya Wilaya ya Paro (katika Kijiji cha Phondrey).
text_en: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Inasemekana kwamba mnamo 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel aliunda ngome hiyo kama ukumbusho wa ushindi wake dhidi ya vikosi vya Tibeti na Mongoli.
text_en: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Mnamo 1951, moto ulifanya baadhi tu ya masalio ya Drukgyal Dzong kubakia, kama vile picha ya Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
text_en: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Baada ya moto, ngome ilihifadhiwa na kulindwa, na kubaki kuwa mojawapo ya vivutio vya kusisimua zaidi vya Bhutan.
text_en: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Wakati wa karne ya 18 Kambodia ilijipata imebanwa katikati mwa majirani wawili wenye nguvu, Thailandi na Vietnam.
text_en: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Wathai walivamia Kambodia mara kadhaa katika karne ya 18 na mnamo 1772 wakaangamiza Phnom Phen.
text_en: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Katika miaka ya mwisho ya karne ya 18 Wavietinamu pia waliivamia Kambodia.
text_en: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Asilimia kumi na nane ya Wavenezuela hawana ajira, na wengi wa wale walioajiriwa hufanya kazi katika sekta isiyo rasmi.
text_en: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Thuluthi mbili ya Wavenezuela ambao hufanya kazi hufanya hivyo katika sekta ya huduma, karibu robo yao hufanya kazi katika viwanda na humusi hufanya kazi katika kilimo.
text_en: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Sekta muhimu kwa Wavenezuela ni mafuta, ambapo nchi hiyo ni wauzaji nje, ingawa ni asilimia moja tu wanaofanya kazi katika sekta ya mafuta.
text_en: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Mapema katika uhuru wa nchi, utaalamu wa Singapori katika Bustani za Mimea uliisaidia katika kukigeuza kisiwa hicho kuwa Mji wa Bustani wa kitropiki.
text_en: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Mnamo 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, okidi mseto, lilichaguliwa kama ua la kitaifa la nchi hiyo.
text_en: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Kila mwaka karibu Oktoba wala-mimea milioni 1.5 husafiri kuelekea nyanda za kusini, na kuvuka Mto Mara, kutoka vilima vya kaskazini kwa ajili ya mvua.
text_en: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: Kisha tena kurudi kaskazini kupitia magharibi, na kuvuka mto Mara mara nyingine tena, baada ya mvua karibu Aprili.
text_en: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Eneo la Serengeti lina Mbuga la Kitaifa la Serengeti, Eneo la Uhifadhi la Ngorongoro na Hifadhi ya Wanyamapori ya Maswa katika Tanzania na Hifadhi ya Kitaifa ya Maasai Mara katika Kenya.
text_en: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Kujifunza kuunda vyombo vya habari vyenye mwingiliano kunahitaji ujuzi wa kawaida na wa jadi, na vile vile vifaa vilivyotengenezwa katika darasa la mwingiliano (hadithi za vibao, uhariri wa sauti na video, hadithi za hadithi, nk.)
text_en: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Ubunifu wenye maingiliano huhitaji kwamba ukague tena dhana zako kuhusu uzalishaji wa midia na ujifunze kufikiria kwa njia zisizo nyoofu.
text_en: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Ubunifu wa maingiliano unahitaji kuwa sehemu za mradi ziunganike, lakini pia ziwe na mantiki kama sehemu tofauti.
text_en: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Ubaya wa lenzi za kupanua au kupunguza mwonekano ni kwamba utata wa kiangalifu na idadi ya elementi za lenzi zinazohitajika kufikia urefu wa kiangalifu ni kubwa zaidi kuliko za lenzi kuu.
text_en: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Hili linaendelea kuwa suala lisilo la muhimu jinsi watengenezaji wa lenzi wanavyofikia viwango vya juu katika uzalizaji wa lenzi.
text_en: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Hii imewezesha lenzi za kukuza kutoa picha zenye ubora unaoweza kulinganishwa na ule unaofikiwa na lenzi zenye urefu msingi usiobadilika.
text_en: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Ubaya mwingine wa lenzi za ukuzaji ni kuwa kilango kipana zaidi (kasi) cha lenzi kwa kawaida huwa cha chini.
text_en: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Hii hufanya lenzi za kukuza za bei ya chini vigumu kutumia katika hali ya mwangaza duni bila mwako.
text_en: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Shida moja ya kawaida wakati wa kujaribu kubadilisha sinema kwenda kwa muundo wa DVD ni kuskani zaidi.
text_en: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Vipindi vingi vya televisheni nyingi hutengenezwa kwa njia ya kufurahisha umma.
text_en: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Kwa sababu hiyo, kila kitu mnachokiona kwenye runinga kilikatwa mipaka, juu, chini na pande.
text_en: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Hii hufanywa ili kuhakikisha picha inafunika skrini yote. Hiyo inaitwa kuskani kulikokithiri.
text_en: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Kwa bahati mbaya, unapotengeneza DVD, kuna uwezekano kingo zake zitakatwa pia, na kama video ilikuwa na maandishi ya tafsiri yaliyokuwa karibu sana na chini, pia hayataonyeshwa.
text_en: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Kasri la kiasili la zama za kati lilichochea dhana, na kuleta picha za mashindano ya kivita, karamu na uungwana wa Kiartha.
text_en: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Hata kwa kusimama katikati mwa magofu ya miaka elfu ni rahisi kuwa na taswira ya sauti na harufu ya vita vilivyopita kitambo, na karibu kusikia mlio wa kwato kwenye barabara za mawe na kunusa uoga kutoka kwenye jela za chini kwa chini.
text_en: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Lakini fikira zetu zina misingi ya ukweli? Mbona ngome zilijengwa pale mwanzoni? Zilibuniwa na kujengwa vipi?
text_en: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Kwa kawaida ya kipindi hicho, Ngome ya Kirby Muxloe ni zaidi ya nyumba ambayo imeimarishwa kuliko ngome ya kweli.
text_en: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Madirisha yenye glasi kubwa na kuta nyembamba hazingeweza kupinga shambulio kwa muda mrefu.
text_en: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Katika miaka ya 1480, wakati ujenzi wake ulipoanzishwa na Bwana Hastings, nchi ilikuwa yenye amani kiasi na ulinzi ulihitajika tu dhidi ya vikundi vidogo vya wanyang’anyi.
text_en: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: Usawasishaji wa mamlaka ulikuwa mfumo ambamo mataifa ya Ulaya yalitafuta kudumisha uhuru wa majimbo yote ya Ulaya.
text_en: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Dhana ilikuwa kwamba mataifa yote ya Ulaya lazima yangejaribu kuzuia taifa moja lisiwe lenye nguvu, na basi serikali za kitaifa mara nyingi zilibadili muungano wao ili kudumisha usawa.
text_en: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: Vita vya Urithi wa Uhispania viliashiria vita vya kwanza ambavyo shida yake kuu ilikuwa usawa wa madaraka.
text_en: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Hii iliashiria mabadiliko muhimu, kwani mamlaka ya Uingereza hawangeweza tena kujifanya kuwa vita vya kidini. Hivyo, Vita hivyo vya Miaka Thelathini vingekuwa vita vya mwisho kuitwa vita vya kidini.
text_en: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Hekalu ya Artemis kule Ephesus iliharibiwa julai 21, 356 BCE kwa kisa cha moto kilichotekelezwa na Herostratus.
text_en: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Kulingana na hadithi, motisha wake ulikuwa umaarufu kwa gharama yoyote. Waefeso, kwa kukasirika, walitangaza kuwa jina la Herostratus lisirekodiwe daima.
text_en: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Mwanahistoria wa Kigiriki Strabo alibaini hilo jina, ambalo ndilo tunavyolijua leo. Hekalu liliharibiwa usiku ule ule Alexander Mkuu alizaliwa.
text_en: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Alexander, kama mfalme, alijitolea kugharimia ujenzi upya wa hekalu, lakini toleo lake lilikataliwa. Baadaye, baada ya Alexander kufa, hekalu lilijengwa upya mnamo 323 BCE.
text_en: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Hakikisha mkono wako umetulia iwezekanavyo huku ukicheza sauti zote kwa usahihi - pia jaribu usifanye misogeo yoyote isiyo muhimu kwa vidole vyako.
text_en: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Hivi, utajisumbua kidogo iwezekanavyo. Kumbuka hakuna haja ya kugonga vibonye kwa nguvu nyingi ili kutoa sauti kubwakama kwenye piano.
text_en: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Kwenye kodiani, kupata sauti ya ziada, unatumia viriba na shinikizo au kasi zaidi.
text_en: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: Utatanishi ni kuau tekeleza ushirika na, utambulisho na, ufahamu wa ukweli wa mwisho, uungu, ukweli au Mungu.
text_en: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Mwamini hutafuta uzoefu wa moja kwa moja, uelewa au maarifa ya ukweli/mungu au miungu
text_en: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Wafuasi hutafuta njia fulani za kuishi, au mazoea ambayo yanakusudiwa kulea uzoefu huo.
text_en: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Imani ya mafumbo inaweza kutofautishwa na aina nyingine za imani na ibada ya kidini kwa msisitizo wake wa uzoefu wa kibinafsi wa moja kwa moja wa hali ya kipekee ya ufahamu, hasa zile za sifa za amani, maarifa, raha au hata msisimko.
text_en: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Kalasinga ni dini kutoka bara ndogo la India. Ilianzia eneo la Punjab katika karne ya 15 kutokana na mgawanyiko wa kimadhehebu katika tamaduni za Kihindu.
text_en: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Makalasinga huchukulia imani yao kuwa kando na Uhindu ingawa wanatambua mizizi na tamaduni zake katika Ubaniani.
text_en: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: Sikhs huiita dini yao Gurmat, ambayo ni Kipunjabi kwa "njia ya guru". Guru ni kipengele msingi cha dini zote za India lakini Ukalasinga umechukua umuhimu ambao hubuni msingi wa imani za Kalasinga.
text_en: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Dini ilianzishwa karne ya 15 na Guru Nanak 1469-1539). Palifuatilia urithi wa walimu tisa.
text_en: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Hata hivyo, mnamo Juni 1956, ahadi za Kruschev ziliwekwa katika jaribio wakati maandamano katika Polandi, ambapo wafanyakazi walikuwa wakipinga upungufu wa chakula na kukatwa kwa mishahara, yaligeuka kuwa maandamano ya jumla dhidi ya Ukomunisti.
text_en: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Ingawa hatimaye, Kruschev alituma vifaru kurejesha utulivu, aliridhia baadhi ya mahitaji ya kiuchumi na akakubali kumteua mtu maarufu Wladyslaw Gomulka kama waziri mkuu mpya.
text_en: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: Ustaarabu wa Indus Valley ulikuwa wa Enzi za Shaba kaskazini magharibi mwa bara ndogo la Hindi, ukijumuisha kwa wingi Pakistani ya sasa na sehemu za kaskazini magharibi mwa Hindu na kaskazini magharibi mwa Afganistani.
text_en: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: Ustaarabu ulinawiri katika bonde la Mto Indus ambapo ulitoa jina lake.
text_en: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Ingawa baadhi ya wasomi hukisia kwamba kwa sababu ustaarabu pia ulikuwapo katika mabonde ya Mto Sarasvati uliokauka sasa, unafaa kuitwa Ustaarabu wa Indus-Sarasvati, huku wengine wakiuita Ustaarabu wa Harappa, kutokana na Harappa, eneo lake la kwanza kuchimbwa katika miaka ya 1920.
text_en: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: Tabia za kijeshi za Milki ya Kirumi zilisaidia sana kwa maendeleo ya matibabu.
text_en: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: Madaktari walianza kuajiriwa na Mtawala Augustus na hata kuunda kitengo kikubwa cha kwanza cha Matibabu cha Kirumi kwa ajili ya kutumika baada ya vita.
text_en: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: Madaktari wa upasuaji walikuwa na uelewa wa vitulizo kadhaa zikiwamo mofini kutoka kwa mbegu za mpopi na scopolamina kutoka kwa mbegu za henbeni.
text_en: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: Walipata kuwa na ustadi wa kukata viungo vya mwili ili kuokoa wagonjwa kutokana na gangrini na vile vile mafundo na vibanio vya mishipa ili kutuliza mtiririko wa damu.
text_en: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: Katika karne nyingi, milki ya Kirumi ilipelekea faida kubwa katika uga wa tiba na ikaunda mengi ya maarifa tunayoyajua leo.
text_en: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: Pureland origami ni origami yenye kizuizi kwamba ni kunjo moja tu linaweza fanywa kwa wakati Fulani, kunjo ngumu zaidi kama kunjo za nyuma haziruhusiwi, na kunjo zote zina maeneo moja kwa moja.
text_en: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

text: Iliundwa na John Smith miaka ya 1970 kusaidia folda walio na ujuzi kidogo au walio na ustadi kidogo wa gari.
text_en: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: Watoto hukuza ufahamu wa utaifa na kasumba za utaifa wakiwa wangali wachanga na kasumba hizo za utaifa huathiri tabia.
text_en: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text: Kwa mfano, watoto ambao wanashirikishwa na uchache wa kabila wanaodhaniwa kuwa hawafanyi vizuri shuleni huwa hawafanyi vizuri shuleni mara tu wanapogundua juu ya dhana linalohusishwa na kabila zao.
text_en: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text: MySpace ni tovuti ya tatu kwa umaarufu inayotumika nchini Marekani na ina wasajili milioni 54 sasa hivi.
text_en: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

text: Tovuti hizi zimepata umakinifu mwingi sana, hasa katika mpangilio wa kielimu.
text_en: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

text: Kuna vipengele chanya kuhusu tovuti hizi, ambazo ni pamoja na, kuwa rahisi kusanidi ukurasa wa darasa ambao unaweza kutia ndani blogu, video, picha, na vipengele vingine.
text_en: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text: Ukurasa huu unaweza kufikiwa kwa urahisi kwa kutoa anwani moja tu ya wavuti, ambayo inaifanya kuwa rahisi kukumbuka na rahisi kuchapa kwa wanafunzi ambao wanaweza kuwa na shida kutumia kibodi au na tahajia.
text_en: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

text: Inaweza kugeuzwa ili iwe rahisi kusoma na pia na rangi nyingi au kidogo kama inavyonuiwa.
text_en: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: Tatizo la Upungufu wa Umakini "ni ugonjwa wa neva ambao dalili zake tatu za kawaida za kuufafanua ni msukumo, mvurugo na utendaji wa kupita kiasi au nguvu za ziada."
text_en: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: Si ulemavu wa kusoma, ni mvurugiko wa kusoma; “unaathiri asilimia 3 hadi 5 ya watoto wote, pengine takriban watoto milioni 2 wa Marekani”.
text_en: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: Watoto walio na ADD huwa na wakati mgumu kuangazia mambo kama kazi za shuleni, lakini wanaweza kukazia fikira mambo wanayopenda kuyafanya kama kucheza michezo au kutazama katuni zao vibwedo au kuandika sentensi bila kuakifisha.
text_en: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Watoto hawa huingia kwenye shida nyingi kwa sababu “wanajihusisha na tabia hatari, wanaingia kwenye vita na kuipa changamoto mamlaka” ili kuchechemua akili zao kwa sababu akili zao haziwezi kuchechemuliwa kwa njia za kawaida.
text_en: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: Ugonjwa wa Upungufu wa Usikivu huathiri uhusiano wao na wenzi wengine kwa sababu watoto wengine hawawezi kuelewa kwa nini wao hujifanya kwa njia hiyo au kwa nini wao huduwaa jinsi wanavyofanya au kwamba kiwango cha kukomaa kwao ni tofauti.
text_en: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text: Jinsi uwezo wa kupata maarifa na kujifunza ulivyobadilika kwa njia kama ilivyoelezewa hapo juu, ndivyo kiwango msingi ambacho kwacho maarifa yalipatikana kilivyobadilika.
text_en: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text: Njia ya kupata habari ilikuwa tofauti. Shaka haikuwa tena ndani ya kumbukumbu ya mtu binafsi, lakini uwezo wa kukumbuka maandishi ukawa wa kuzingatiwa zaidi.
text_en: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text: Kimsingi, Kipindi cha Mwamko kilifanya mabadiliko muhimu katika mbinu za kujifunza na usambazaji wa maarifa.
text_en: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: Tofauti na nyani wengine, hominidi hawatumii mikono yao kwa kutembea, kubebea uzito au kubembea kwenye miti.
text_en: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text: Mkono na mguu wa sokwe ni sawa kwa ukubwa na urefu, kuonyesha matumizi ya mkono kwa kubeba uzito katika kutembea kwa konzi.
text_en: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text: Mkono wa binadamu ni mfupi kuliko mguu, na una mifupa minyoofu zaidi..
text_en: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

text: Visukuku vya mifupa ya mikono vilivyo na miaka milioni mbili hadi milioni tatu vinafunua haya mabadiliko ya utaalam wa mkono kutoka kwa kuusongesha na kuutumia.
text_en: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text: Watu wengine wanaamini kuwa kupata ndoto nyingi bandia mara nyingi kunaweza kuchosha sana.
text_en: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text: Sababu kuu ya jambo hili ni matokeo ya ndoto dhahiri kupanua kipindi cha wakati kati ya majimbo ya REM.
text_en: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

text: Ikiwa na vipindi vifupi vya usogezaji macho kwa haraka, hali hii ambapo unapata usingizi halisi na mwili wako kupata nafuu huwa nadra kiasi cha kuwa tatizo.
text_en: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

text: Hii inachosha sawa na ungekuwa unaamka baada ya kila dakika ishirini au thelathini na kutazama runinga.
text_en: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

text: Athari inategemea ni mara ngapi ubongo wako hujaribu kupata ndoto dhahiri.
text_en: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

text: Mambo hayakwenda vizuri kwa Waitaliano katika Afrika Kaskazini tangu karibu mwanzoni. Ndani ya wiki tangu Italia kutangaza vita mnamo Juni 10, 1940, Hussar wa 11 wa Kiingereza walikuwa wameteka Ngome ya Kapuzo huko Libya.
text_en: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.

text: Katika shambulizi mashariki mwa Bardia, Wazungu walimkamata Mhandisi Mkuu wa Jeshi la Kumi la Kiitaliano, Jenerali Lastucci.
text_en: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.

text: Mnamo Juni 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, Gavana Mkuu wa Libya na mrithi dhahiri wa Mussolini, aliuawa kimakosa alipokuwa akitua huko Tobruk.
text_en: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.

text: Mchezo wa kisasa wa kupigana kwa sime huchezwa kwa viwango vingi, toka wanafunzi wanaosoma katika chuo kikuu hadi mashindano ya kitaalamu na Olimpiki.
text_en: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.

text: Mchezo huo huchezwa kimsingi kwa muundo wa kupigana, mchezaji mmoja akipigana na mwingine.
text_en: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.

text: Gofu ni mchezo ambao wachezaji hutumia rungu kuingiza mipira mashimoni.
text_en: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.

text: Mashimo kumi na manane huchezwa wakati wa duru ya kawaida, na wachezaji kawaida huanzia shimo la kwanza kwenye uwanja na kumalizia kwenye shimo la kumi na nane.
text_en: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.

text: Mchezaji ambaye hufanya mipigo michache zaidi, au mizunguko ya rungu, kukamilisha mkondo hushinda.
text_en: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

text: Mchezo huo huchezwa kwenye nyasi, na nyasi zilizo karibu na shimo hukatwa ziwe fupi na huitwa kijani kibichi.
text_en: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.

text: Pengine aina ya kawaida zaidi ya utalii ni ambayo watu wengi huhusisha na usafiri: Utalii wa burudani.
text_en: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

text: Huu ni wakati watu wanaenda mahali ambapo ni tofauti sana na maisha yao ya kawaida ya kila siku kupumzika na kufurahia.
text_en: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

text: Pwani, bustani maalum na nyanja za kambi mara nyingi huwa sehemu ambazo hutembelewa sana na watalii wa kujiburudisha.
text_en: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text: Kama lengo la mwafulani la kutembelea mahali maalum ni kujua historia na utamaduni wake basi aina hii ya utalii inajulikana kama utalii wa kitamaduni.
text_en: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text: Watalii wanaweza kutembelea alama tofauti za ardhi za nchi maalum au wanaweza tu kuchagua kuangazia eneo moja tu.
text_en: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text: Wakoloni, walipoona shughuli hii, pia waliita wasaidizi.
text_en: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.

text: Majeshi yanayoimarisha nafasi za mbele ni pamoja na ya 1 na ya 3 ya majeshi ya New Hampshire yaliyo na wanaume 200, yaliyo chini ya makanali John Stark na James Reed (ambao baadaye wote walikuwa majenerali).
text_en: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

text: Wanaume wa Stark walichukua nafasi kando ya uzio upande wa kaskazini mwa nafasi ya Mkoloni.
text_en: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

text: Wakati kupwa kwa maji kulifungua mwanya katika Mto Mystic katika kaskazini mashariki mwa rasi, waliendeleza ua kwa haraka kwa ukuta mfupi wa mawe upande wa kaskazini na kuishia kwenye ukingo wa maji katika pwani ndogo.
text_en: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

text: Gridley au Stark aliweka nguzo umbali wa kama futi 100 (mita 30) mbele ya uzio na akaamuru kwamba hakuna atakayeiwasha moto hadi watu wa kawaida watakapokuwa wameipita.
text_en: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.

text: Mpango wa Marekani ulitegemea uanzishaji wa mashambulio yaliyoratibiwa kutoka pande tatu tofauti.
text_en: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.

text: Jenerali John Cadwalder alianzisha shambulio la kupotosha dhidi ya ngome ya Uingereza katika Bordentown, ili kuzuia usaidizi wowote.
text_en: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

text: Jenerali James Ewing angewachukua wanamgambo 700 na kuvuka mto huko Kivukio cha Trenton, kutwaa kwa nguvu daraja iliyoko juu ya Asunpink Creek na kuwazuia wanamgambo wowote adui kutoroka.
text_en: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

text: Kikosi kikuu cha ushambuliaji chenye wanaume 2,400 kilivuka mto maili tisa kaskazini mwa Trenton, kisha kugawanyika kwa vikundi viwili, kimoja chini ya Greene na kingine chini ya Sullivan, ili kuanzisha shambulio kabla ya macheo.
text_en: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

text: Kwa mabadiliko kutoka mbio za robo hadi nusu maili, kasi huwa yenye umuhimu mdogo zaidi na ustahimilivu ukawa hitaji lenye umuhimu kabisa.
text_en: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

text: Kwa kweli mkimbiaji wa daraja la kwanza wa nusu maili, mtu anayeweza kufuzu kwa dakika mbili, lazima awe na kasi ya kutosha, lakini uvumilivu lazima ustawishwe wakati wote wa hatari.
text_en: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

text: Mbio kiasi za mashambani katika msimu wa baridi, pamoja na shughuli katika ukumbi wa mazoezi kwa ajili ya sehemu ya juu ya mwili, ndiyo maandalizi bora ya msimu wa mbio.
text_en: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text: Mazoea ya lishe sahihi pekee haiwezi kuzalisha usomi wa utendaji, ila yanaweza kuathiri kwa kiasi kikubwa na ustawi wa wakimbiaji wachanga kwa ujumla.
text_en: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text: Kudumisha uwiano bora wa kawi, kuwa na mazoea ya unywaji wa maji yenye ufanisi, na kuelewa vipengele tofauti vya mazoea ya ziada kunaweza kusaidia wanariadha kuboresha utendaji wao na kuongeza raha yao katika spoti hiyo.
text_en: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text: Mbio za umbali wa kati ni spoti isiyo ghali sana; hata hivyo, kuna dhana nyingi potovu kuhusu zana chache zinazohitajika ili kushiriki.
text_en: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

text: Bidhaa zinaweza kununuliwa zinapotakikana, lakini nyingi zitakuwa na athari ndogo au isiyo halisi kwa utendaji.
text_en: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

text: Wanariadha wanaweza kuhisi wanapendelea bidhaa hata kama haina manufaa halisi.
text_en: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

text: Atomu inaweza kuchukuliwa kama mojawapo ya mawe msingi ya ujenzi ya dutu zote.
text_en: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text: Ni chombo tata ambacho kulingana na mfano uliorahisishwa wa Bohr, kina nyuklia ya kati inayozungukwa na elektroni, sawa na sayari zinavyozunguka jua - ona Mchoro 1.1.
text_en: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

text: Nyuklia ina chembe mbili - nyutroni na protoni.
text_en: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text: Protoni zina chaji chanya ya umeme wakati neutroni hazina chaji. Elektroni zina chaji hasi ya umeme.
text_en: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

text: Ili Kumwangalia mwathirika, ni lazima kwanza uchunguze eneo ili kuhakikisha usalama wako.
text_en: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

text: Unahitaji kugundua nafasi ya mwathiriwa unapoenda kumkaribia na kiashiria vyovyote vya kawaida vya hatari.
text_en: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

text: Ikiwa utaumia ukijaribu kusaidia, huenda utafanya mambo kuwa mabaya zaidi tu.
text_en: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.

text: Utafiti ulionyesha kwamba mafadhaiko, uoga na kutia janga chumvi kulipatanisha uhusiano kati ya uchungu na ulemavu kwa walio na maumivu ya sehemu ya chini ya mgongo.
text_en: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

text: Ni athari tu za kutia janga chumvi, si mafadhaiko na uoga, zilizokuwa na masharti ya vipindi vya PA vya mara kwa mara kila wiki.
text_en: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.

text: Walioshiriki katika shughuli za mara kwa mara walihitaji usaidizi zaidi kubainisha tofauti za uchungu sugu na hisia za usumbufu kutokana na msogeo wa kawaida wa kimwili, kuhusiana na mtazamo hasi wa uchungu.
text_en: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text: Uonaji, au uwezo wa kuona hutegemea viungo vya hisia vya mfumo wa kuona au macho.
text_en: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text: Kuna miundo tofauti ya macho, yaliyo ya utata tofauti kulingana na mahitaji ya kiumbe.
text_en: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text: Miundo tofauti ina uwezo tofauti, ni myepesi kwa masafa tofauti ya mawimbi na yana viwango tofauti vya ukali, pia inahitaji uchakataji tofauti ili kuelewa ingizo na nambari tofauti ili kufanya kazi kwa ubora.
text_en: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text: Idadi ni mkusanyiko wa viumbehai wa spishi maalum ndani ya eneo fulani la kijiografia.
text_en: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: Wakati kila mmoja katika idadi ya wakazi ni sawa kwa kuzingatia tabia fulani ya maumbile wanajulikana kama wanajinsia moja.
text_en: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Wakati watu wanaonyesha tofauti kadhaa za tabia fulani wanasemekana kuwa polimofiki.
text_en: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text: Makoloni ya siafu huandamana na kuishi katika awamu tofauti vilevile.
text_en: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

text: Katika awamu ya kuhamahama, siafu huandamana usiku na kusimama na kukita kambi mchana.
text_en: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.

text: Koloni huanza awamu ya kuhamahama wakati chakula kilichopo kimepunguka. Katika awamu hii, koloni hutengeneza viota visivyo vya kudumu ambavyo hubadilishwa kila siku.
text_en: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text: Kila moja haya mabwawa ya kuhamahama au maandamano hudumu takriban siku 17.
text_en: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: Seli ni nini? Neno cell linatokana na neno la Kilatini "cella", linalomaanisha "chumba kidogo", na lilibuniwa mara ya kwanza na mtaalamu wa hadubini alipokuwa akitazama muundo wa dutu ya mwaloni.
text_en: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: Seli ni sehemu msingi ya vitu vyote vilivyo hai, na viumbehai wote wameundwa kwa moja au zaidi ya seli hizi.
text_en: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: Seli ni msingi na muhimu kwa kujifunza hali ya maisha, na kwa kweli mara nyingi inatambulika kama vitalu vya kujenga maisha.
text_en: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: Mfumo wa neva hudumisha hali ya ndani kwa kutuma mipwito ya neva mwilini kote ili kudumisha mkondo wa damu pia bila usumbufu.
text_en: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Mipwito hii ya neva inaweza kutumwa haraka sana mwilini kote ambayo huweka mwili salama dhidi ya hatari yoyote.
text_en: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: Vimbunga hupiga sehemu ndogo ikilinganishwa na dhoruba zingine kali, lakini vinaweza kuharibu kila kitu kilichopo njiani mwao.
text_en: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: Tufani hung’oa miti, kupasua mbao kutoka kwa majengo, na kurusha magari juu angani. Asilimia mbili ya tufani zenye vurugu zaidi hudumu kwa zaidi ya saa tatu.
text_en: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: Dhoruba hizi za ajabu zina upepo wa hadi kilomita 480 kwa saa (mita 133 kwa sekunde; maili 300 kwa saa).
text_en: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

text: Binadamu wamekuwa wakitengeneza na kutumia lenzi za kukuza kwa maelfu na maelfu ya miaka.
text_en: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text: Hata hivyo, darubini halisi za kwanza zilitengenezewa Uropa katika karne ya 16.
text_en: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: Darubini hizi zilitumia mchanganyiko wa lenzi mbili kufanya vitu vilivyo mbali kuonekana kuwakaribu na kubwa.
text_en: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text: Tamaa na ubinafsi siku zote zitakuwa nasi na ni hali ya ushirikiano kwamba wakati wengi wanafaidika siku zote kutakuwa na mengi ya kufaidi kwa muda mfupi kwa kutenda kiubinafsi.
text_en: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text: Kwa matumaini, watu wengi watagundua kwamba chaguo lao bora la kudumu ni kufanya kazi pamoja na wengine.
text_en: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text: Watu wengi huota kuhusu siku ambayo wanadamu wanaweza kusafiri kwa nyota nyingine na kuvumbua ulimwengu mwingine. Watu wengine hushangaa ni nini iko huko nje, wengine wanaamini kuwa wageni au maisha mengine yanaweza kuishi kwenye sayari nyingine.
text_en: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text: Lakini, iwapo hili litawahi kutokea labda halitatokea kwa muda mrefu sana. Nyota zimetawanyika sana kiasi kwamba kuna matrilioni ya maili katikati ya nyota ambazo ni “majirani”.
text_en: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text: Pengine siku moja, vitukuu wako watasimama juu ya ulimwengu wa kigeni wakiwaza kuhusu mababu zao wa zamani?
text_en: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text: Wanyama wametengenezwa kwa seli nyingi. Wao hula vitu na kuvimeng’enyea ndani. Wanyama wengi wanaweza kusonga.
text_en: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

text: Ni wanyama tu walio na bongo (ingawa hata si wanyama wote walio nazo; kwa mfano, viwavi wa baharini hawana bongo).
text_en: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

text: Wanyama hupatikana duniani kote. Wanachimba ardhini, wanaogelea kwenye bahari, na wanaruka angani.
text_en: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text: Seli ni sehemu ndogo ya kimuundo na ya kazi ya viumbe (vitu) hai.
text_en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text: Seli linatokana na neno cella la Kilatini ambalo humaanisha chumba kidogo.
text_en: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text: Ukitazama vitu vyenye uhai chini ya hadubini, utaona kwamba vimeudwa kwa miraba au mipira midogo.
text_en: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text: Robert Hooke, mtaalamu wa biolojia kutoka Uingereza, aliona miraba midogo kwenye kizibo kwa darubini.
text_en: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.

text: Zilionekana kama vyumba. Alikuwa mtu wa kwanza kuona seli zilizokufa.
text_en: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells

text: Elementi na misombo zinaweza kusonga kutoka hali moja hadi nyingine na zikose kubadilika.
text_en: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

text: Nitrojeni kama gesi bado ina sifa sawa na nitrojeni oevu. Hali oevu nzito kiasi lakini molekyuli bado ni sawa.
text_en: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text: Maji ni mfano mwingine. Msombo maji umeundwa kwa atomu mbili za hidrojeni na atomu moja ya oksijeni.
text_en: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text: Ina muundo sawa wa kimolekyuli iwe ni gesi, kioevu, au mango.
text_en: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text: Ingawa hali yake ya mwili inaweza kubadilika, hali yake ya kikemikali inabaki ile ile.
text_en: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: Wakati ni kitu ambacho kinatuzingira, na huathiri kila kitu tunachofanya, lakini ni ngumu kuelewa.
text_en: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: Wakati umesomwa na wasomi wa kidini, kifalsafa, na kisayansi kwa maelfu ya miaka.
text_en: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: Sisi hupata saa kama msururu wa matukio unaopita kutoka wakati ujao kupitia wakati uliopo hadi kwenye wakati uliopita.
text_en: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: Saa pia ni jinsi tunavyolinganisha kipindi (urefu) cha matukio.
text_en: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: Unaweza kuweka alama ya upitaji wa saa wewe mwenyewe kwa kuangalia marudio ya tukio la kimzunguko. Tukio la kimzunguko ni kitu ambacho hutukia tena na tena mara nyingi.
text_en: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text: Tarakilishi leo hutumiwa kuumbua picha na video.
text_en: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

text: Michoro ya kisasa inaweza kujengwa kwenye kompyuta, na aina hii ya uhuishaji inazidi kutumiwa kwenye runinga na filamu.
text_en: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: Muziki kwa kawaida hurekodiwa kutumia kompyuta tata ili kuchakata na kuchanganya sauti pamoja.
text_en: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

text: Kwa muda mrefu wakati wa karne za kumi na tisa na ishirini, iliaminika wakazi wa kwanza wa Nyuzilandi walikuwa watu wa Maori, waliowinda ndege wakubwa walioitwa moa.
text_en: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text: Basi nadharia ikaanzisha wazo kwamba watu wa Maori walihama kutoka Polynesia katika Kundi Kubwa na kuchukua Nyuzilandi kutoka kwa Moriori, na kuanzisha jamii ya kilimo.
text_en: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text: Hata hivyo, ushahidi mpya unadokeza kwamba Moriori walikuwa kundi la Maori wa bara waliohama kutoka Nyuzilandi hadi Visiwa vya Chatham, na wakakuza utamaduni wao wenyewe wa kipekee na wenye amani.
text_en: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text: Kulikuwa pia na makabila mengine kwenye visiwa vya Chatham, ambao walikuwa Maori waliohamia Nyuzilandi.
text_en: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: Walijiita Moriori kulikuwa na mapigano machache na mwishowe, Moriori wakauawa wote
text_en: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out

text: Watu waliohusika kwa miongo kadhaa walitusaidia kuthamini uwezo na shauku zetu huku tukitathmini shida na hata kutofaulu kwa uwazi.
text_en: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: Wakati wa kusikiliza watu wakishirikisha hadithi za kibinafsi, kifamilia au kishirika, tulipata ufahamu wa kale wenye thamani na baadhi ya watu ambao waliathiri utamaduni wa shirika kwa njia nzuri au mbaya.
text_en: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Wakati kuelewa historia ya mtu hakumaanishi kuelewa utamaduni, angalau huwasaidia watu kupata hisia za mahali waliko katika historia ya shirika.
text_en: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: Wakati wa kutathmini mafanikio na kufahamu kutofaulu, watu binafsi na watu wote wanaoshiriki hugundua kwa kina zaidi maadili, misheni na nguvu za uendeshaji za shirika.
text_en: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: Kwa wakati huu, kukumbuka matukio ya awali ya tabia za ujasiriamali na mafanikio yaliyofuatia kulisaidia watu kuwa wazi kwa mabadiliko mapya na mwelekeo mpya wa kanisa la kienyeji.
text_en: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: Hadithi kama hizi za mafanikio zilipunguza hofu ya mabadiliko, huku zikiunda mielekeo chanya kuhusu mabadiliko wakati ujao.
text_en: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: Mifumo inayobadilika ya fikira ni mbinu za utatuzi wa shida ambazo zinaunganisha maoni au nyanja tofauti ili kupata suluhisho.
text_en: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: Angazio la mtazamo huu ni kasi, mantiki na usahihi, pia utambuzi wa ukweli, kutumia tena mbinu zilizopo, kukusanya taarifa.
text_en: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: Kipengele muhimu zaidi cha mtazamo huu ni: kuna jibu moja tu sahihi. Unafikiria majibu mawili tu, yaani sahihi au kosa.
text_en: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text: Aina hii ya fikira inahusishwa na taratibu fulani za kisayansi au kawaida.
text_en: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: Watu wenye aina hii ya kufikiria wana mawazo ya kimantiki, wanaweza kukariri miundo, kutatua shida na kufanya majaribio ya kisayansi.
text_en: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: Kwa umbali wanadamu ndio spishi yenye talanta zaidi katika kusoma akili za wengine.
text_en: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text: Hilo linamaanisha tunaweza kutabiri kile binadamu wengine wanachohisi, kukusudia, kuamini, kujua au kutamani kwa ufanisi.
text_en: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text: Katika uwezo huu, kuelewa nia ya wengine ni muhimu. Huturuhusu kutatua uwezekano wa utata katika vitendo halisi vya kimwili.
text_en: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: Kwa mfano, ikiwa ungeona mtu akivunja dirisha la gari, labda ungedhani alikuwa anajaribu kuiba gari la mtu usiyemjua.
text_en: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text: Angehitaji kuhukumiwa tofauti ikiwa angepoteza funguo za gari lake na lilikuwa gari lake mwenyewe ambalo alikuwa akijaribu.
text_en: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: MRI ni ya msingi wa fizikia inayoitwa nyuklia mwangwi wa sumaku (NMR), ambayo iligunduliwa katika 1930s na Felix Bloch (anayefanya kazi katika Chuo Kikuu cha Stanford) na Edward Purcell (kutoka Chuo Kikuu cha Harvard).
text_en: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: Katika tasnifu hii, uga wa sumaku na wimbiredio husababisha atomi kutoa ishara ndogo za redio.
text_en: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: Katika mwaka wa 1970, Raymond Damadian, daktari wa kimatibabu na mtafiti wa kisayansi, aligundua msingi wa kutumia picha za mwangwi wa sumaku kama kifaa cha utambuzi wa kimatibabu.
text_en: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Miaka minne baadaye leseni ilitolewa, ambayo ilikuwa leseni ya kwanza ulimwenguni iliyotolewa katika sehemu ya MRI
text_en: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: Mwaka wa 1977, Dak. Damadian alikamilisha ujenzi wa mdaki wa MRI wa mwili wote ambao aliuita “kisicho epukika”.
text_en: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: Mawasiliano mengi ya kisolandanifu huchochea muda wa kutafakari na kuitikia wengine.
text_en: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: Huwaruhusu wanafunzi uwezo wa kufanya kazi kwa mwendo wao wenyewe na kudhibiti mwendo wa taarifa za mafundisho.
text_en: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: Isitoshe, kuna vizuizi vichache vya saa na uwezekano wa saa huru za kufanya kazi. (Bremer, 1998)
text_en: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: Matumizi ya intaneti na Wavuti wa Ulimwengu Wote unaruhusu wanafunzi kupata habari kila wakati.
text_en: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: Wanafunzi wanaweza pia kupeleka maswali kwa waalimu wakati wowote wa siku na wanatarajia majibu ya haraka, badala ya kungojea mkutano wa uso-kwa-uso utakaofuata.
text_en: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: Njia ya usasa ya kujifunza hutoa uhuru kutoka kwa kanuni mahsusi. Hakuna njia moja nzuri ya kujifunza.
text_en: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text: Kwa kweli, hakuna jambo hata moja zuri la kujifunza. Kujifunza hufanyika katika uzoefu kati ya mwanafunzi na maarifa yanayowasilishwa.
text_en: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: Uzoefu wetu wa sasa wa fanya-mwenyewe na uwasilishaji wa taarifa, vipindi vya televisheni vyenye msingi wa kujifunza, vinaonyesha pointi hii.
text_en: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Kwa hivyo wengi wetu hujipata tukitazama kipindi cha runinga ambacho hutujulisha kuhusu mchakato au uzoefu ambao hatutawahi kushiriki au kutumia maarifa hayo.
text_en: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text: Hatutawahi kukarabati gari lote, kujenga chemchemi katika ua letu la nyuma, kusafiri Peru kukagua magofu ya kale, au kubuni upya nyumba ya jirani.
text_en: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text: Shukrani kwa viungo vya kebo za nyuzi za kioo chini ya bahari katika Uropa na satelaiti pana yenye bendi za masafa mapana, Greenland imeunganishwa vizuri na asilimia 93 ya watu wana ufikiaji wa intaneti.
text_en: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text: Hoteli au wenyeji wako (ikiwa unakaa katika nyumba ya wageni au nyumba ya kibinafsi) ina uwezekano wa kuwa na WiFi au kompyuta iliyounganishwa kwenye intaneti, na makao yote yana duka la huduma za intaneti au mahali fulani palipo na WiFi ya umma.
text_en: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: Kama ilivyosemwa hapo juu, ijapokuwa neno “Eskimo” limebaki kukubalika Marekani, linachukuliwa kuwa la dharau na wengi watu wengi wa Aktika wasiokuwa wa Marekani, haswa katika Canada.
text_en: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: Wakati unaweza kusikia neno hilo likitumiwa na Wenyeji wa Grinilandi, wageni wanapaswa kuepuka kulitumia.
text_en: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text: Wenyeji wa Greenland hujiita Inuit huko Canada na Kalaalleq (kwa wingi Kalaalit), Greenlander, katika Greenland.
text_en: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: Uhalifu, na uhasidi kwa wageni kwa jumla, haujulikani katika Grinlandi. Hata katika miji, hakuna “maeneo mabaya”.
text_en: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text: Hali ya hewa ya baridi labda ndiyo hatari tu ambayo wasiyojiandaa watakuta.
text_en: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: Ikiwa utatembelea mji wa Greenland wakati wa msimu wa baridi (ukizingatia kuwa jinsi unavyokwenda kaskazini ndivyo inavyozidi kuwa baridi), ni muhimu kuleta mavazi ya kutosha ya joto.
text_en: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.
