text: Siku ndefu sana katika msimu wa kiangazi zinaweza kupelekea shida za kupata usingizi wa kutosha na shida za kiafya zinazohusika.
text_en: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: Wakati wa kiangazi, pia jihadhari na mbu wa Skandinavia. Ingawa hawaenezi magonjwa, wanaweza kukera.
text_en: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: Huku uchumi wa San Francisco ukiunganishwa nayo kuwa kivutio cha watalii cha kimataifa, uchumi wake ni mseto.
text_en: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: Sekta kubwa zaidi za ajira ni huduma za kitaalamu, serikali, fedha, biashara, na utalii.
text_en: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: Kuonyeshwa kwake mara kwa mara katika muziki, filamu, fasihi na utamaduni maarufu kumesaidia kuufanya mji huo na minara yake ijulikane ulimwenguni kote.
text_en: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: San Francisko imekuza miundombinu kubwa ya watalii ambayo ni hoteli mikahawa, na vifaa vingi, vya kongamano vya hali ya juu.
text_en: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: San Francisco pia ni mojawapo ya mahali bora nchini kwa vyakula vya Kiasia: Korea, Thai, India, na Japani.
text_en: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: Kusafiri kuenda Ulimwengu wa Walt Disney inawakilisha hija kuu kwa familia nyingi za Amerika.
text_en: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: Ziara ya "kawaida" inajumuisha kutua kwenye Uwanja wa kimataifa wa ndege wa Orlando, kusafiri kwa basi hadi kwenye hoteli ya Disney, kukaa karibu wiki bila kutoka kwa miliki za Disney, na kurudi nyumbani.
text_en: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: Kuna tofauti zisizo na kikomo zinazopatikana, lakini hili linabaki kuwa jambo ambalo watu wengi humaanisha wanaposema wanaenda Ulimwengu wa Disney”."
text_en: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Tiketi nyingi zinazouzwa mtandaoni kupitia tovuti za minada kama eBay au Craiglist ni zilizotumika kidogo za siku nyingi za kutembelea mbuga nyingi.
text_en: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Ingawa hii ni shughuli ya kawaida sana, imekatazwa na Disney: tiketi haziwezi kuhamishwa.
text_en: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Ukitaji kambi wowote chini ya ukingo katika Grand Canyon unahitaji kibali cha sehemu za mashambani.
text_en: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: Vibali hupunguzwa kulinda korongo na hupatikana katika siku ya kwanza ya mwezi, mienzi nne kabla ya mwezi kuanza.
text_en: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Kwa hivyo, idhini ya kurudi nchini kwa tarehe yoyote ya kuanza mwezi Mei inapatikana mnamo tarehe 1 Januari.
text_en: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: Nafasi katika maeneo maarufu zaidi, kama vile Bright Angel Campground karibu na Phantom Ranch, kwa jumla hujaa kwa maombi yanayopokewa siku ya kwanza yanapofunguliwa kwa uhifadhi.
text_en: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: Kuna idadi ndogo ya vibali zilizohifadhiwa kwa maombi ya papo hapo zinazopatikana kwa hali ya fika kwanza, hudumiwa kwanza.
text_en: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Kuingia Afrika Kusini kwa gari ni njia ya ajabu ya kuona uzuri wote wa eneo vilevile kufika mahali kusiko katika njia za kawaida za watalii.
text_en: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Hii inaweza kufanywa kwenye gari la kawaida kwa mipango makini lakini inapendekezwa sana gari la 4 kwa 4 na sehemu nyingi zinaweza kufikika tu kwa gari la 4 kwa 4 lenye magurudumu mapana.
text_en: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Zingatia wakati wa kupanga kwamba ingawa Kaskazini mwa Afrika ni imara si nchi zote jirani zilizo imara.
text_en: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: Mahitaji na gharama ya visa hutofautiana toka nchi hadi nchi na huathiriwa na nchini unakotoka.
text_en: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Kila nchi pia ina sheria za kipekee zinazotaja ni vifaa vipi vya dharura unavyohitaji kuwa navyo garini mwako.
text_en: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Victoria Falls ni mji ulioko katika sehemu ya magharibi mwa Zimbabwe, kuvuka mpaka kutoka Livingstone, ya Zambia, na karibu na Botswana.
text_en: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: Jiji liko mara moja karibu na maporomoko ya maji ambayo ndiyo kivutio kikuu, lakini sehemu hii maarufu ya watalii huwatolea wanaotafuta kusisimka na kutembea maeneo mbali mbali fursa ya kukaa kwa muda mrefu.
text_en: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: Katika msimu wa mvua (Novemba hadi Machi), kiasi cha maji kitakuwa cha juu na maporomoko ya maji yatakuwa ya fujo sana.
text_en: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: Umehakikishiwa kupata unyevunyevu ukiweza kuvuka daraja ama kutembea kando ya njia zinazozunguka karibu na Maporomoko.
text_en: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: Kwa upande mwingine, ni kwa sababu kiwango cha maji hususan ni kikubwa sana hivi kwamba mtazamo wako wa Maporomoko halisi ya Maji utazuiliwa – na maji yote!
text_en: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: Kaburi la Tutankhamun (KV62). Huenda KV62 ndilo kaburi maarufu zaidi katika Bonde, eneo la ugunduzi wa Howard Carter wa mazishi salama ya kifalme ya mfalme mchanga mnamo 1922.
text_en: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Ikilinganishwa na makaburi mengine mengi ya kifalme, hata hivyo, kaburi la Tutankhamun halistahili sana kutembelewa, ni dogo sana na lina mapambo machache.
text_en: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Mtu yeyote aliye na shauku ya kuona ushahidi wa uharibifu uliofanyiwa maiti ya kale wakati wa kujaribu kuitoa kutoka kwa jeneza atasikitika kuwa ni kichwa na mabega tu zinazoonekana
text_en: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: Utajiri mwingi wa kaburi haupo tena ndani yake, ila umepelekwa katika Jumba la Makumbusho la Misri huko Kairo.
text_en: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Ni bora wageni wasiokuwa na muda mrefu kutumia muda wao mahali pengine.
text_en: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom, kilomita 12 kusini magharibi mwa Siem Reap. Hekalu hili la kilimani lilijengwa mwishoni mwa karne ya 9, wakati wa utawala wa Mfalme Yasovarman.
text_en: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: Mazingira yenye huzuni ya hekalu na mwonekano wa ziwa la Tonle Sap ulifanya ukweaji kilima kuwa wa maana.
text_en: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Ziara katika eneo hilo inaweza kujumuishwa kwa urahisi na safari ya ziwa katika boti.
text_en: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Kibali cha Angkor kinahitajika ili kuingia katika hekalu kwa hivyo usisahau kubeba pasipoti yako unapoelekea Tonle Sap.
text_en: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Yerusalemu ni mji mkuu na mkubwa zaidi wa Israeli, ijapokuwa nchi nyingine nyingi na Umoja wa Mataifa haziutambui kama mji mkuu wa Israeli.
text_en: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Mji wa kale katika Vilima vya Judea una historia ya kusisimua ya maelfu ya miaka.
text_en: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Mji ni mtakatifu kwa dini tatu zinazomwamini Mungu mmoja - Dini ya Kiyahudi, Ukristo na Uislamu, na hutumika kama kituo cha kiroho, kidini, na kitamaduni.
text_en: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Kwa sababu ya umuhimu wa kidini wa mji huo, na hususan sehemu nyingi za maeneo ya Mji wa Zamani, Yerusalemu ni mojawapo ya sehemu kuu zinazowavutia watalii nchini Israeli.
text_en: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Yerusalemu ina sehemu nyingi za kihistoria, akiolojia na kitamaduni, pamoja na vituo vya ununuzi, mahoteli na migahawa mahariri na iliyojaa.
text_en: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Ekuado inahitaji kwamba raia wa Cuba wapate barua ya mwaliko kabla ya kuingia Ekuado kupitia viwanja vya ndege vya kimataifa ama vituo vya uandikishaji kwenye mipaka.
text_en: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Barua hii ni lazima ihalalishwe na Wizara ya Mambo ya Nje ya Kiekwado, na itimize mahitaji fulani.
text_en: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Mahitaji haya yameandaliwa ili kutoa uhamiaji ulioandaliwa kati ya nchi zote mbili.
text_en: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Wananchi wa Kuba ambao wana kadi ya kijani ya Marekani, wanaweza kutembelea ubalozi wa Ekuado ili kusamehewa hitaji hili.
text_en: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Pasipoti yako lazima iwe halali kwa angalau miezi 6 zaidi ya tarehe zako za kusafiri. Tikiti ya safari ya kwenda na kurudi/kuendelea inahitajika ili kudhibitisha urefu wa kukaa kwako.
text_en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Ziara huwa bei nafuu kwa vikundi vikubwa, kwa hivyo kama uko peke yako au na rafiki mmoja tu, jaribu kukutana na watu wengine na kuunda kikundi cha watu wanne hadi sita kwa bei bora kwa mtu mmoja.
text_en: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Hata hivyo, kwa kweli hii haifai kukosa kukupa wasiwasi, kwa sababu mara nyingi watalii huchanganywachanganywa ili kuyajaza magari.
text_en: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: Inaonekana kweli kuwa njia zaidi ya kuwadanganya watu kuamini wanapaswa kulipa zaidi
text_en: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Juu ya mwisho wa kaskazini mwa Machu Picchu ni mlima ulio na mwinuko, mara nyingi ni uwanja wa nyuma wa picha nyingi za magofu.
text_en: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Inaonekana kutisha kutoka chini, na ni mwinuko mkali na mgumu, lakini watu wanaokusudiwa kuwa na hali nzuri ya mwili wanapaswa kuwa na uwezo wa kuupanda kwa dakika kama 45.
text_en: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Hatua za mawe zimewekwa kando ya idadi kubwa ya vijia, na katika sehemu za mteremko nyaya za chuma hutoa reli za kushikiliwa inayounga mikono.
text_en: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Hilo likiwa limesemwa, tarajia kuishiwa na pumzi, na kuwa mwangalifu katika sehemu zenye mwinuko mno, haswa wakati wa unyevunyevu, kwa sababu inaweza kuwa hatari haraka.
text_en: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Kuna pango ndogo karibu na juu ambalo lazima lipitwe, liko chini kabisa na la kubana sana.
text_en: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Kuona mandhari na wanyamapori wa Galapagos hufanywa vizuri kwa boti, kama vile Charles Darwin alivyofanya mnamo 1835.
text_en: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Zaidi ya meli 60 za kifahari husafiri kwenye maji ya Galapagos - zikiwa zenye saizi ya abiria 8 hadi 100.
text_en: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Watu wengi huhifadhi nafasi zao mapema sana (kwani kwa kawaida boti hizo hujaa wakati wa msimu wenye shughuli nyingi).
text_en: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Hakikisha kwamba wakala unayetumia kupata uhifadhi ni mtaalamu wa Galapagos aliye na maarifa mengi ya aina tofauti tofauti za meli.
text_en: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Hii itahakikisha kwamba masilahi na/au vizuizi vyako vinalingana na meli inayowafaa zaidi.
text_en: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Kabla ya Wahispania kuwasili katika karne ya 16, Chile kaskazini ilikuwa chini ya utawala wa Inca huku wenyeji Waarauka (Mapuche) wakiishi Chile ya kati na kaskazini.
text_en: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Mapuche pia walikuwa mojawapo ya vikundi huru asilia vya Marekani, ambavyo havikuzama kabisa katika sheria ya Kihispania hadi baada ya uhuru wa Chile.
text_en: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Ingawa Chile ilitangaza uhuru mnamo 1810 (katikati mwa vita vya Kinapoleoni ambavyo viliacha Uspanya bila serikali kuu thabiti kwa miaka kadhaa), ushindi kamili dhidi ya Uspanya haukufikiwa hadi 1818.
text_en: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: Jamhuri ya Dominika (Kihispania: Republica Dominicana) ni nchi ya Karibi ambayo imechukua nusu ya kisiwa cha Hispaniola, ambacho inashirikisha na Haiti.
text_en: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Kando na pwani zenye mchanga mweupe na mandhari ya milima, nchi hiyo ni nyumbani mwa mji wa zamani zaidi wa Kiingereza katika Amerika, ukiwa sasa sehemu ya Santo Domingo.
text_en: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Wenyeji wa kwanza wa kisiwa walikuwa Wataino na Wakaribi. Wakaribi walikuwa watu wenye kuongea lugha ya Arakwan waliokuwa wamefika takribani mwaka wa 10,000 BCE.
text_en: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Kwa kipindi cha miaka michache mifupi kufuatia kuwasili kwa wavumbuzi wa Ulaya, idadi ya watu ya Tainos ilikuwa imepunguzwa sana na washindi wa Kihispania.
text_en: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Kulingana na Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) kati ya 1492 na 1498 washindi wa Kispanya waliwaua takribani Wataino 100,000.
text_en: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardin de la Union. Nafasi hii ilijengwa kama nyumba ya watawa ya karne ya 17, ambapo Templo de San Diego ndilo jengo pekee lililopo sasa.
text_en: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Sasa inafanya kazi kama magulio ya kati, na daima ina mambo mengi yanayoendelea, mchana na usiku.
text_en: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Kuna mikahawa kadhaa inayozunguka bustani, na katika nyakati za adhuhuri na jioni maonyesho ya bure hufanywa huko katika gazebo iliyo katikati.
text_en: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso (Kichochoro cha busu). Roshani mbili zilizotengwa na sentimita 69 tu ni nyumba ya shujaa mkongwe wa mapenzi.
text_en: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Kwa mapeni machache baadhi ya watoto watakusimulia hadithi hiyo.
text_en: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Kisiwa cha Bowen ni maarufu kwa safari ya mchana ama safari ya wikendi na inatoa safari za kayaki, matembezi, maduka, migahawa, na nyinginezo.
text_en: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Jamii hii halisi iko katika Howe Sound nje ya Vancouver, na inafikiwa kwa urahisi kupitia teksi za majini zilizoratibiwa zinazoondoka Kisiwa cha Granville katika Vancouver ya chini.
text_en: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Kwa wale ambao hufurahia shughuli za nje, matembezi kwenye korido toka Baharini hadi Angani ni muhimu.
text_en: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Whistler (mwendo wa saa 1.5 kutoka Vancouver) ni pa bei ghali lakini panajulikana kwa sababu ya Olimpiki ya Msimu wa Baridi ya 2010.
text_en: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: Katika msimu wa baridi, furahia baadhi ya utelezaji mzuri wa Marekani Kaskazini na katika msimu wa joto jaribu uendeshaji baiskeli halisi milimani.
text_en: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Ni lazima vibali vihifadhiwe mapema. Lazima uwe na kibali ili kukaa usiku kucha.
text_en: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sirena ndicho kituo pekee cha walinzi ambacho hutoa malazi ya bweni na vyakula moto pamoja na kambi. La Leona, San Pedrillo, na Los Patos hutoa kambi bila huduma ya chakula.
text_en: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Inawezekana kupata vibali vya mbuga moja kwa moja kutoka kwa Kituo cha Walinzi katika Puerto Jimerez, lakini hawakubali kadi za deni.
text_en: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: Huduma ya Mbuga (MINAE) haitoi vibali vya zaidi ya mwezi mmoja kabla ya kutarajiwa kwa kuwasili.
text_en: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: CafeNet El Sol hutoa huduma ya kuhifadhi kwa ada ya dola 30 za Kimarekani na pasi za siku moja kwa dola 10 za kimarekani; maelezo kwenye ukurasa wao wa Corcovado.
text_en: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Visiwa vya Cook ni nchi ya kisiwa katika ushirika huru na Nyuzilandi, iliyoko Polynesia, katikati mwa Bahari la Pasifiki ya Kusini.
text_en: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Ni funguvisiwa lililo na visiwa 15 vilivyoenea zaidi ya mraba wa kilometa milioni 2.2 ya bahari.
text_en: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Vikiwa katika eneo la saa sawa na Hawaii, wakati mwingine visiwa hivyo hufikiriwa kuwa "Hawaii ya chini kwa chini".
text_en: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Ingawa kidogo, huwakumbusha baadhi ya wageni wakongwe wa Hawaii wakati kabla ya utaifa bila mikahawa yote mikubwa ya watalii na maendeleo mengine.
text_en: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Visiwa vya Cook havina miji yoyoyte lakini vinajumuisha visiwa 15 tofauti. Vikuu kati yazo ni Rarotonga na Aitutaki.
text_en: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Katika nchi zilizoendelea leo, kuandaa kitanda cha deluksi na kiamshakinywa imeimarishwa kwa aina fulani ya kisanaa.
text_en: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Mwishowe, ni wazi kwamba B&Bs hushindana haswa kwenye vitu viwili vikuu: matandiko na kiamsha kinywa.
text_en: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Ipasavyo, katika bora zaidi ya vituo hivyo mtu anafaa kupata matandiko ya kistarehe zaidi, pengine firasha iliyotengenezwa kwa mkono au kitanda cha kizamani.
text_en: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Kiamsha kinywa kinaweza kujumuisha faraha za misimuwa kutoka katika eneo au mlo maalum ya mwenyeji.
text_en: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Kikao kinaweza kuwa kwenye jumba nzee la kihistoria lililo na vyombo vya kale, uwanja wenye nyasi zilizokatwa vizuri na bwawa la kuogelea.
text_en: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Kuingia kwenye gari lako na kuelekea kwa safari ya mbali ya barabara kuna mvutio wa ndani kwa urahisi wake.
text_en: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: Tofauti na magari makubwa, labda tayari unajua kuendesha gari lako na unajua mapungufu yake.
text_en: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Kuweka hema kwenye mali ya kibinafsi au katika mji wa saizi yoyote kunaweza kuvutia watu wasiofaa.
text_en: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: Kwa kifupi, kutumia gari lako ni njia mwafaka ya safari za barabarani lakini nadra kwa gari lenyewe kuwa njia ya “kupiga kambi”.
text_en: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Kupiga kambi kwenye gari kunawezekana kama una minivani, SUV, Sedan au Stesheni Wagon lenye viti ambavyo vinaweza kulazwa.
text_en: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Baadhi ya hoteli zina urithi kutoka kwenye zama za usitawi za reli za mvuke na meli kubwa kubwa za abiria; kabla ya Vita vya Pili vya Dunia, katika karne za 19 au 20 mapema.
text_en: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Hizi ni hoteli ambazo watu tajiri na maarufu enzi zile wangeishi, na mara nyingi walikula na kujitumbuiza.
text_en: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Zana hizo za kale, ukosefu wa huduma za kisasa, na uzee fulani wenye neema pia ni sehemu ya tabia zao.
text_en: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Japo huwa zinamilikiwa kibinafsi, wakati mwingine huwa zinatumiwa kuwapokea marais wanaozuru, pamoja na waheshimiwa wengine.
text_en: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Msafiri aliye na vitita vya pesa huenda akafikiria safari ya ndege kuzunguka ulimwengu, inayositishwasitishwa kwa kukaa katika nyingi ya hoteli hizi.
text_en: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Kubadilishana mitandao ya ukarimu ndio shirika linalounganisha wasafiri na wenyeji kwenye miji wanayoizuru.
text_en: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Kujiunga na mtandao kama huo kwa kawaida kunahitaji tu kujaza fomu ya mtandaoni; hata hivyo mitandao mingine itatoa ama kuhitaji uhakiki zaidi.
text_en: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Orodha ya wenyeji wanaopatikana hutolewa kwa kuchapishwa kwenye nakala na/au mitandaoni, wakati mwingine pamoja na marejeleo na hakiki kutoka kwa wasafiri wengine.
text_en: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Kulala kwenye nyumba za watu kwa muda kulianzishwa mnamo Januari 2004 baada ya mtengenezaji wa programu za kompyuta Casey Fenton kupata safari ya ndege ya bei nafuu kuelekea Aislandi lakini hakuwa na mahali pa kukaa.
text_en: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: Akawatumia wanafunzi wa chuo kikuu chaa ndani barua pepe na akapata matoleo mengi sana ya malazi ya bure.
text_en: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Hosteli hushughulikia vijana kimsingi - mgeni wa kawaida ana miaka ishirini hivi - lakini mara nyingi unaweza kuwapata wasafiri wazee huko pia.
text_en: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Familia zilizo na watoto si jambo la kawaida, lakini baadhi ya hosteli huwaruhusu katika vyumba vya kibinafsi.
text_en: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Mji wa Beijing nchini Uchina utakuwa mji mwenyeji wa mashindano ya Olimpiki ya Msimu wa Baridi mwaka wa 2022, ambayo itaifanya Beijing kuwa mji wa kwanza kuwa mwenyeji wa Olimpiki ya majira ya joto na baridi.
text_en: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Beijing itakuwa mwenyeji wa sherehe za kufungua na kufunga na matukio ya ndani kwenye barafu.
text_en: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Matukio mengine ya kuteleza kwenye theluji yatakuwa katika eneo la Taizicheng katika Zhangjiakou, takribani kilomita 220 (maili 140) kutoka Beijing.
text_en: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Hekalu nyingi zina sikukuu ya Kila mwaka kuanzia mwishoni mwa Novemba hadi katikati mwa Mei, ambayo hufautiana kulingana na kalenda ya mwaka ya kila hekalu.
text_en: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Sherehe nyingi za Hekaluni zinaadhimishwa kama sehemu ya maadhimisho ya hekalu au siku ya kuzaliwa kwa mungu anayeongoza au tukio lolote jingine kuu linalohusiana na hekalu.
text_en: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Tamasha za hekalu za Kerala ni za kufurahisha sana kuona, kwa msafara wa mara kwa mara wa ndovu waliopambwa, bendi za hekalu na tamasha nyinginezo.
text_en: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Maonyesho ya Dunia (kwa kawaida yanajulikana kama World Exposition, au Expo tu) ni tamasha kubwa ya kimataifa ya sanaa na sayansi.
text_en: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Nchi zinazoshiriki huwasilisha maonyesho ya kisanaa na kielimu katika kumbi za kitaifa ili kuonyesha masuala ya kidunia au utamaduni na historia ya nchi yao.
text_en: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: Maonyesho ya Kimataifa ya Maua ni matukio maalum ambayo huonyesha maonyesho ya maua, bustani za mimea na kitu chochote kingine kinachohusisha mimea.
text_en: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Ingawa katika nadharia zinaweza kutokea kila mwaka (mradi zako katika nchi tofauti), kwa mazoezi hazipo.
text_en: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Matukio hayo huwa kwa miezi mitatu hadi miezi sita, na hufanyika kwenye maeneo yasiyopungua hekta 50.
text_en: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Kuna aina nyingi za filamu ambazo zimetumika kwa miaka. Filamu ya milimita 35 (kanda hasi ya milimita 36 kwa milimita 24) ni ya kawaida zaidi.
text_en: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Kwa kawaida inaweza kujazwa tena kwa urahisi kiasi ikiisha, na hutoa ubora wa mwonekano unaoweza kulinganishwa na ule wa DSLR ya sasa.
text_en: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Kamera ingine za muundo wa kati zinatumia muundo wa 6 kwa 6, kwa usahihi 56 kwa 56 hasi.
text_en: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Hii hutoa ubora wa mwonekano karibu mara nne ya ule wa picha hasi ya milimita 35 (3136 mm2 dhidi ya 864).
text_en: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Wanyama pori ni miongoni mwa michoro yenye changamoto zaidi kwa mpiga picha, na inahitaji mchanganyiko wa bahati nzuri, uvumilivu, uzoefu na vifaa vizuri.
text_en: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Upigaji picha za wanyamapori mara nyingi huchukuliwa kwa urahisi, lakini kama upigaji picha kwa ujumla, picha ina thamani ya maneno elfu.
text_en: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Mara nyingi upigaji picha za wanyamapori huhitaji lenzi ndefu, ingawa vitu kama kundi la ndege au kiumbe mdogo huhitaji lenzi nyingine.
text_en: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Ni vigumu kupata wanyama wengi wa kigeni, na mbuga wakati mwingine huwa na sheria zinazohusu upigaji picha kwa ajili za kibiashara.
text_en: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Wanyamapori wanaweza kuwa wenye aibu au wakali. Mazingira yanaweza kuwa baridi, joto, au makali kwa vinginevyo.
text_en: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Ulimwengu una zaidi ya lugha 5,000, zikiwemo zaidi ya ishirini zilizo na wazungumzaji zaidi ya milioni 50.
text_en: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Maneno yaliyoandikwa mara nyingi huwa rahisi kuelewa kuliko maneno yaliyotamkwa, pia. Hii huwa hususan ni kweli kwa anwani, ambazo aghalabu huwa vigumu kutamkwa kwa busara.
text_en: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Mataifa mengi mazima huzungumza Kiingereza kwa ufasaha kabisa, na kwa hata mengine mengi unaweza kutarajia ufahamu mdogo - hasa miongoni mwa watu wenye umri mdogo.
text_en: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Fikiria, ukitaka, Mmankunia, Mbostonia, Mjamaika, na Msydney wakiwa wameketi wamezunguka meza wakila chajio mkahawani katika Toronto.
text_en: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Wanaburudishana na hadithi kutoka kwa mitaa ya manyumbani kwao, inayosemwa katika lafudhi zao tofauti na lugha ya kienyeji isiyo rasmi.
text_en: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Kwa kawaida, kununua chakula katika supamaketi ndiyo njia ya bei rahisi kabisa ya kujilisha. Bila fursa za kupika, machaguo hata hivyo yamepunguzwa kwa chakula kilichotengenezwa tayari.
text_en: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Maduka makubwa yanazidi kupata seehemu ya chakula kilichotengenezwa tayari. Baadhi ya maduka makuu hutoa tanuri ya miale ya kupasha chakula joto.
text_en: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: Katika baadhi ya nchi au aina za maduka kuna angalau mkahawa kwenye eneo, mara nyingi usio wa kirasmi na wenye bei nafuu.
text_en: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Tengeneza na ubebe nakala za hati ya bima na maelezo ya mawasiliano ya mtoa huduma wako wa bima.
text_en: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Wanahitaji kuonyesha anwani ya barua pepe na nambari za simu za kimataifa za mtoa bima kwa ushauri/idhini na kufanya madai.
text_en: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Kuwa na nakala nyingine katika mzigo wako na mtandaoni (baruapepe iliyo na kiambatisho kwako mwenyewe, au kuhifahiwa kwenye “wingu”).
text_en: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Kama unafasiri na kipakatilishi au kibao, hifadhi nakala kwenye kadi kasima yake(unayoweza kufikia bila mtandao)
text_en: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Pia toa nakala za sera/mkataba kwa wenzi wa kusafiri na jamaa au marafiki nyumbani walio tayari kusaidia.
text_en: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Kongoni (pia wanajulikana kama elk) hawana fujo kiasili, lakini watajitetea ikiwa watakisia kuna hatari.
text_en: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Wakati watu hawaoni kongoni kama anayeweza kuwa hatari, huenda wakamsogea karibu sana na kujiweka hatarini.
text_en: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Kunywa vinywaji vyenye pombe kwa kiasi tu. Pombe inaathiri kila mtu kwa njia tofauti, na kujua kiwango chako ni muhimu sana.
text_en: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Matukio ya kiafya ya muda mrefu kutokana na kunywa kupita kiasi yanaweza kujumuisha uharibifu wa ini na hata upofu na kifo. Kuwepo kwa hatari huongezeka wakati wa kunywa pombe iliyotengenezwa kiharamu.
text_en: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Mivinyo isiyo halali inaweza kuwa na uchafu mwingi hatari pamoja na methanoli, ambayo inaweza kusababisha upofu au kifo hata kwa kiasi kidogo.
text_en: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Miwani inaweza kuwa bei rahisi katika nchi ya kigeni, haswa katika nchi za mapato ya chini ambapo gharama za kazi ziko chini.
text_en: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Fikiria kufanyiwa uchunguzi wa macho nyumbani, haswa ikiwa bima inaugharamia, na kuleta agizo nawe ili lifailiwe mahali pengine.
text_en: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Fremu za kifahari za kampuni tajika ambazo hupatikana katika maeneo kama haya zina shida mbili; baadhi huenda zikawa ni nakala zisizo na leseni, na zile halisi zilizoletwa ndani huenda zikawa ghali zaidi kuliko nyumbani.
text_en: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Kahawa ni mojawapo ya bidhaa zinazouzwa sana duniani, na labda unaweza kupata aina nyingi katika eneo lako la nyumbani.
text_en: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Walakini, kuna njia nyingi za kipekee za kunywa kahawa ulimwenguni kote ambazo zinafaa kushuhudiwa.
text_en: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Kuingia kwenye korongo (au: canyoneering) ni kuhusu kwenda chini ya korongo, ambayo imekauka au imejawa na maji.
text_en: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Mchezo wa korongo huchanganya vipengele kutoka kuogelea, kupanda na kuruka--lakini unahitaji mafunzo kiasi au hali nzuri ya kimwili ili kuanza (ukilinganishwa na kupanda mwamba, upigaji mbizi wa scuba au kuteleza milimani, kwa mfano).
text_en: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Matembezi ni shughuli ya nje ambayo huwa na kutembea katika mazingira asili, mara nyingi katika njia za matembezi.
text_en: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Matembezi ya mchana huhusisha umbali wa chini ya maili hadi umbali zaidi ambao unaweza kufikiwa kwa siku moja.
text_en: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Kwa matembezi ya mchana kando ya njia rahisi maandalizi kidogo yanahitajika, na mtu yeyote aliye na usawa wastani wa kimwili anaweza kufurahia.
text_en: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Huenda familia zilizo na watoto wadogo zikahitaji matayarisho mengi, lakini siku moja nje inawezekana kwa urahisi hata kukiwa na watoto wachanga na wale walio karibu kwenda shuleni.
text_en: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Kimataifa, kuna mashirika karibu 200 ya ziara za mbio. Nyingi kati yazo hufanya kazi kwa uhuru.
text_en: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Mrithi wa Global Running Tours, Go Running Tours huunganisha makundi mengi ya kutoa huduma ya ukimbiaji na utazamaji kwenye mabara manne.
text_en: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Kwa mizizi ya Running Tours huko Barcelona na Copenhagen’s Running kwa Copenhagen, ilijumuishwa haraka na Running Tours huko Prague na wengineo.
text_en: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Kuna mambo mengi sana unayofaa kutilia maanani kabla na wakati wa kusafiri mahali.
text_en: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Unaposafiri, tarajia mambo yasiwe kama yalivyo “nyumbani”. Tabia, sheria, chakula, trafiki, mahali pa kulala, viwango, lugha na kadhalika zitatofautiana kwa kiwango fulani na mahali unapoishi.
text_en: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Hili ni jambo ambalo unahitaji kukumbuka kila wakati, ili kuepuka kukata tamaa au hata kuchukizwa na njia za kawaida za kufanya mambo.
text_en: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Mawakala wa usafiri wamekuwapo tangu karne ya 19. Kwa kawaida wakala wa usafiri huwa chaguo zuri kwa safari ambayo ni zaidi ya uzoefu wa awali wa msafiri wa maumbile, utamaduni, lugha au nchi za mapato madogo.
text_en: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Ingawa mashirika mengi ya uwakala yako tayari kufanya uhifadhi mwingi wa kawaida, mawakala wengi hushughulika na aina maalum za usafiri, masafa ya bajeti au mahali pa kwenda.
text_en: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Programu za utafsiri wa matini kwa wakati halisi – programu-tumizi ambazo zina uwezo wa kutafsiri sehemu nzima za matini kutoka lugha moja kwa nyingine kiotomatiki.
text_en: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Baadhi ya programu-tumizi katika kategoria hii zinaweza hata kutafsiri matini ya lugha za kigeni kwenye vibao vya ishara au vitu vingine katika dunia halisi wakati mtumiaji anapoelekeza simu maizi kwenye vitu hivyo.
text_en: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: Injini za utafsiri zimeimarika sana, na sasa mara nyingi hutoa tafsiri inayokaribia usahihi (na kawaida huwa si upuzi), lakini umakini unahitajika, kwani zinaweza kuwa zimekosea kabisa.
text_en: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Mojawapo ya programu maarufu sana katika kategoria hii ni Google Translate, ambayo huruhusu utafsiri nje ya mtandao baada ya kupakua data ya lugha inayotakikana.
text_en: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: Kutumia programu za kuabiri za GPS kwenye rununu yako kunaweza kuwa njia rahisi na bora ya kuabiri ukiwa nje ya nchi yako.
text_en: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: Inaweza kuokoa pesa badala ya kununua ramani mpya za GPS, au kifaa cha GPS kinachojisimamia au kukodisha kimoja kutoka kwa kampuni ya kukodisha magari.
text_en: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Ikiwa huna muunganisho wa data kwa simu yako, au ikiwa mbali na masafa, utendakazi wake utakwazika au hautakuwepo.
text_en: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Kila duka la karibu limejawa na aina nyingi za kukanganya za kadi za simu za kulipia kabla ambazo zinaweza kutumika katika simu za kulipia au simu za kawaida.
text_en: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: Huku kadi nyingi zikiwa nzuri kwa kupiga simu kila mahali, nyingine ni maalumu kwa kutoa gharama za chini za kupiga simu kwa vikundi mahususi vya mataifa.
text_en: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: Ufikiaji wa huduma hizi mara nyingi ni kupitia nambari ya simu isiyolipishwa ambayo inaweza kupigwa kutoka simu nyingi bila malipo.
text_en: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Kanuni kuhusu upigaji picha za kawaida pia hutumika kwa kurekodi video, pengine hata zaidi.
text_en: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Ikiwa kupiga picha ya kitu tu hakuruhusiwi, basi hupaswi hata kufikiria kurekodi video yake.
text_en: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Ikiwa unatumia ndege-roboti, angalia mapema ni nini unachoruhusiwa kuchukua filamu yake na ni vibali au leseni gani za ziada zinazohitajika.
text_en: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Kurusha kidege-roboti karibu na uwanja wa ndege juu ya umati wa watu ni wazo mbaya karibu kila wakati, hata kama si haramu katika eneo lako.
text_en: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: Siku hizi usafiri wa ndege huhifadhiwa moja kwa moja mara chache kupitia kampuni ya ndege bila kwanza kutafuta na kulinganisha bei.
text_en: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: Wakati mwingine safari moja inaweza kuwa na bei zinazotofautiana sana katika wajumuishaji tofauti na ina faida kulinganisha matokeo ya utafutaji na pia kuangalia tovuti ya kampuni ya ndege yenyewe kabla ya kuhifadhi.
text_en: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: Wakati huenda usihitaji visa kwa ziara fupi katika nchi fulani kama mtalii au kwa biashara, kwenda huko kama mwanafunzi wa kimataifa kwa jumla kunahitaji kukaa kwa muda mrefu kuliko kwenda huko kama mtalii wa kawaida tu.
text_en: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: Kwa ujumla, kukaa kwenye nchi ya kigeni kwa muda mrefu zaidi kunahitaji upate visa mapema.
text_en: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: Kwa jumla visa za wanafunzi huwa na mahitaji na utaratibu wa maombi tofauti na visa za kawaida za kitalii au kibiashara.
text_en: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: Kwa nchi nyingi, utahitaji barua ya ofa kutoka kwa taasisi ambayo unataka kusomea, na pia ushahidi wa pesa za kujisaidia kwa angalau mwaka wa kwanza wa kozi yako.
text_en: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Angalia katika taasisi, vilevile idara ya uhamiaji ya nchi ambako unahitaji kusomea kwa mahitaji ya kina.
text_en: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: Isipokuwa kama wewe ni mwanadiplomasia, kufanya kazi ughaibuni kwa jumla humaanisha kwamba utalazimika kufaili ushuru wa mapato nchini uliko.
text_en: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: Ushuru wa mapato huundwa kwa njia tofauti katika nchi tofauti, na viwango na vikundi vya ushuru hutofautiana pakubwa toka nchi moja hadi nyingine.
text_en: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: Katika baadhi ya nchi za shirikisho, kama vile Marekani na Kanada, ushuru wa mapato hutozwa katika ngazi ya shirikisho na pia ngazi ya ndani, kwa hivyo viwango na vikundi vinaweza kutofautiana toka eneo hadi eneo.
text_en: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: Wakati kuangaliwa kwa uhamiaji kawaida haupo au ni urasmi ukifika katika nchi yako, udhibiti wa forodha unaweza kuwa shida.
text_en: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Hakikisha unajua kile unachoweza na hauwezi kuleta kisha kutangaza kitu chochote juu ya mipaka ya kisheria.
text_en: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: Njia ilio rahisi kuanza biashara ya uandishi wa usafiri ni kuonyeshana ujuzi wako kwenye tovuti ya blogu ya usafiri iliyo imara.
text_en: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Unaporidhika na umbizo na uhariri kwenye wavuti, basi baadaye, labda utaunda tovuti yako mwenyewe.
text_en: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Kujitolea wakati wa kusafiri ni njia nzuri ya kuleta mabadiliko lakini si kuhusu utoaji tu.
text_en: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Kuishi na kujitolea katika nchi ya kigeni ni njia bora ya kupata kujua utamaduni mpya, kukutana na watu wapya, kujifunza juu yako mwenyewe, kupata hisia za mtazamo na hata kupata ujuzi mpya.
text_en: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: Pia inaweza kuwa njia bora ya kupanua bajeti ili kuwezesha kukaa mahali kwa muda mrefu kwani kazi nyingi za kujitolea hutoa vyumba na malazi na baadhi hulipa mshahara kidogo.
text_en: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: Maharamia wa Skandinavia walitumia njia za majini za Kirusi kufika kwenye Bahari Nyeusi na Bahari ya Kaspi. Sehemu za njia hizo bado zinaweza kutumika. Angalia uwezekano wa kuhitaji vibali maalum, ambavyo huenda ikawa vigumu kuvipata.
text_en: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: Mfereji kati ya Bahari Nyeupe na Baltic huunganisha Bahari kuu ya Atiki na Bahari ya Baltic, kupitia Ziwa Onega, Ziwa Ladoga na Saint Petersburg, mara nyingi kwa mito na maziwa.
text_en: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: Ziwa Onega limeunganishwa na Volga, kwa hivyo bado inawezekana kusafiri kutoka Bahari Caspian kupitia Urusi.
text_en: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Kuwa na uhakika ya kwamba unapofika bandarini, kila kitu kitakuwa dhahiri. Utapatana na waombajilifti wa machua wengine na watashiriki habari nawewe.
text_en: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: Kimsingi utakuwa unaweka matangazo kuhusu msaada wako, kutembea katika gati, kuongelesha watu wanaosafisha mashua zao, kujaribu kuwasiliana na mabaharia kwenye baa, na kadhalika.
text_en: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Jaribu kuongea na watu wengi iwezekanavyo. Baada ya muda mfupi kila mtu atakujua na watakutolea vidokezo kuhusu ni boti ipi inayotafuta mtu.
text_en: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: Unafaa kuchagua kampuni ya Usafiri wa Mara Nyingi katika muungano kwa makini.
text_en: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: Ingawa unaweza kudhani ni bora zaidi kujiunga na kampuni ya ndege unayotumia zaidi, unapaswa kujua kuwa marupurupu yanayotolewa mara nyingi ni tofauti na pointi za usafiri wa mara kwa mara huenda zikawa karimu zaidi chini ya kampuni tofauti katika muungano mmoja.
text_en: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: Kampuni za ndege kama vile Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways na Turkish Airlines zimepanua huduma zao pakubwa katika Afrika, na hutoa miunganisho kwenye miji mingi muhimu ya Afrika kwa bei bora kuliko kampuni nyingine za Uingereza.
text_en: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: Shirika la ndege la Uturuki hupaa angani kwenda kwa vituo 39 katika nchi 30 za Kiafrika kuanzia mwaka wa 2014.
text_en: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: Ikiwa unao wakati wa ziada wa kusafiri, angalia uone jinsi ankarakifani yako ya jumla ya nauli kwenda Afrika inalingana na nauli ya kuuzunguka ulimwengu.
text_en: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: Usisahau kuongeza gharama za ziada za visa za ziada, ushuru wa kuondoka, usafiri kwenye ardhi, n.k., kwa sehemu hizo zote nje ya Afrika.
text_en: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: Ikiwa unataka kusafiri kuzunguka ulimwengu katika Kizio cha Kusini, machaguo ya ndege na mahali si mengi kwa sababu ya ukosefu wa ndege zinazosafiri kuvuka bahari.
text_en: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: Hakuna muungano wa ndege unaohudumia vivukio vyote vitatu vya bahari katika Ulimwengu wa Kusini (na hakuna kivukio ambacho SkyTeam inahudumia).
text_en: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Hata hivyo, Star Alliance hushughulikia kila kitu isipokuwa South Pacific ya mashariki kutoka Santiago de Chile kwenda Tahiti, ambayo ni safari ya LATAM Oneworld.
text_en: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: Safari hii ya ndege siyo chaguo la pekee kama unataka kuruka Pasifiki Kusini na pwani ya magharibi ya Marekani Kusini. (tazama chini)
text_en: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: Mnamo 1994, eneo la Azabaijan lililo la Nagorno-Karabakh kikabila lilifanya vita dhidi ya Azeris.
text_en: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: Kwa kuungwa mkono na Armenia, jamhuri mpya iliundwa. Hata hivyo, hakuna nchi thabiti - si hata Armenia - huitambua kirasmi.
text_en: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: Hoja za kidiplomasia dhidi ya eneo hilo zinaendelea kutatiza uhusiano kati ya Armenia na Azerbaian.
text_en: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: Wilaya ya Canal (Kiholanzi: Grachtengordel) ni wilaya maarufu ya karne ya 17 inayozunguka Binnenstad ya Amsterdam.
text_en: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: Wilaya nzima imeteuliwa kama Pahali pa Urithi wa Shirika la Umoja wa Mataifa la Elimu, Sayansi na Utamaduni kwa thamani yake ya kipekee ya kitamaduni na kihistoria, na thamani yake ya mali ni kati ya zile za juu zaidi ya nchi.
text_en: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: Cinque Terre, yaani Ardhi Tano, ina vijiji vitano vya kipwani vya Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza na Monterosso vilivyo katika eneo la Kiitaliano la Liguria.
text_en: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: Wameorodheshwa katika Orodha ya Urithi wa Dunia ya UNESCO.
text_en: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: Kwa karne nyingi, watu walijenga matuta kwa umakini katika mandhari yenye mawemawe na mwinuko hadi kwenye majabali yaliyo juu ya bahari.
text_en: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: Sehemu ya haiba yake ni ukosefu wa maendeleo ya shirika yanayoonekana. Njia, treni na maboti huunganisha vijiji, na magari hayawezi kuvifikia kutoka nje.
text_en: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: Aina za Kifaransa zinazozungumzwa katika Ubelgiji na Uswizi zinatofautiana kidogo na Kifaransa kinachozungumzwa Ufaransa, ingawa zinalingana kiasi cha kueleweka baina yazo.
text_en: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: Hasa, mfumo wa hesabu katika Ubelgiji na Uswizi zinazozungumza Kifaransa una mambo yasiyo ya kawaida ambayo ni tofauti na Kifaransa kinachozungumzwa Ufaransa, na matamshi ya maneno kadhaa ni tofauti kidogo.
text_en: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Walakini, Wabelgiji wote waliozungumza Kifaransa na Kiswisi walijifunza Kifaransa shuleni, kwa hivyo wangeweza kukuelewa hata ukitumia mfumo wa nambari wa Kifaransa.
text_en: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: Katika sehemu nyingi za dunia, kupunga mkono ni ishara ya kirafiki, kuashiria "hujambo."
text_en: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: Walakini, huko Malaysia, angalau kati ya Malay katika maeneo ya vijijini, inamaanisha "kuja huku," sawa na kidole cha kwanza kilichoelekezwa kuelekea kwenye mwili, ishara ambayo hutumiwa katika nchi fulani za Magharibi, na inapaswa kutumiwa tu kwa sababu hiyo.
text_en: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: Vivyo hivyo, msafiri wa Uingereza huko Uhispania anaweza kukosea kuagana kwaheri kwa kupepa kuhusisha viguzo akikabilia mpepapi (badala ya mtu anayepepewa) kama ishara ya kurudi.
text_en: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: Lugha saidizi ni lugha bandia au za kubuniwa zinazoundwa kwa lengo la kusaidia mawasiliano kati ya watu ambao vinginevyo wangepata shida ya kuwasiliana.
text_en: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: Wao ni tofauti na lingua Francas, ambayo ni lugha asilia au ya kikaboni ambazo huwa maarufu kwa sababu moja au nyingine kama njia ya mawasiliano kati ya wasemaji wa lugha nyingine.
text_en: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Katika joto la siku, wasafiri wanaweza kuona mazigazi ambayo hutoa dhana ya maji (au vitu vingine).
text_en: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: Hizi zinaweza kuwa hatari ikiwa msafiri atafuata mazigazi, kupoteza nishati ya thamani na maji iliyobaki.
text_en: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: Hata jangwa lililo na joto zaidi linaweza likawa baridi sana usiku. Hipothemia ni hatari halisi bila mavazi ya joto.
text_en: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: Katika kiangazi, hasa, utahitaji kujihadhari na mbu ukiamua kutembea katika msitu wa mvua.
text_en: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: Hata ikiwa unaendesha kupitia msitu wa mvua wa kitropiki ndogo, sekunde chache milango ikiwa wazi unapoingia kwenye gari ni muda unaotosha kwa mbu kuingia na wewe garini.
text_en: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: Homa ya ndege inaweza kuambukiza ndege na pia mamalia.
text_en: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: Kesi chache chini ya elfu zimewahi kuripotiwa kwa wanadamu, lakini baadhi yazo zilipelekea kifo.
text_en: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: Mengi yamehusisha watu ambao hufanya kazi na kuku, lakini pia kuna hatari kiasi kwa watazama ndege.
text_en: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: Kawaida kwa Norwei kuwa na vilango-bahari vyenye miinuko mikali na mabonde ambayo ghafla hugeuka kuwa kilima kirefu tambarare ambacho ni bapa, kwa kadiri fulani.
text_en: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: Nyanda hizi za juu mara nyingi huitwa "vidde" kumaanisha nafasi pana, wazi isiyo na miti, eneo lisilo na mipaka.
text_en: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: Katika Rogaland na Agder kwa kawaida huitwa "hei" kumaanisha ardhi iliyotengwa isiyo na miti na mara nyingi hufunikwa na mimea ya vichakani.
text_en: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: Mabarafuto si imara, lakini yanatiririka kuenda chini ya mlima. Hii itasababisha nyufa, mianya, ambayo inaweza kufichwa na madaraja ya theluji.
text_en: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: Kuta na paa za mapango ya barafu zinaweza kuporomoka na nyufa zinaweza kuzibwa.
text_en: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text: Kwenye ukingo wa barafuto vipande vikubwa hujitenga, kuanguka na pengine kuruka au kubingirika mbali zaidi na ukingo.
text_en: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text: Msimu wa watalii kwa vituo vya vilimani kwa jumla hupata shughuli nyingi wakati wa kiangazi cha Kihindi.
text_en: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text: Hata hivyo, vina urembo na haiba ya aina fulani wakati wa msimu wa baridi, na vituo vingi vya vilima hupata viwango vya kutosha vya theluji na kutoa shughuli kama utelezaji na utelezaji kwa vibao.
text_en: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text: Ni mashirika machache tu ya ndege ambayo bado hutoa nauli ya kufiwa, ambayo hupunguza kidogo gharama ya kusafiri kwa mazishi dakika ya mwisho.
text_en: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

text: Ndege zinazotoa hizi ni pamoja na Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa kwa ndege zinazotoka Marekani au Kanada, na WestJet.
text_en: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.

text: Katika visa vyote, lazima ujitengee nafasi mapema kwa kupiga simu moja kwa moja kwenye shirika la ndege.
text_en: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
